title: Review duplicate identities
intro: Compare both source records and their private relationships before deciding whether they represent the same party or property.
empty: No eligible source records are shown on this page.
kept: Each source keeps its own recorded fields, facts, aliases and history. This decision creates only the canonical identity link.
retained: All listed references stay with their original source and audience. No contact method, account, participation, grant, document or provider receipt is reassigned.
noReferences: Neither record has an affected reference in the checked source scope.
chooseSurvivor: Choose which identity will be canonical
mappingHint: The retained alias keeps its own source workbench and permission boundaries. Canonical navigation independently checks access to each source.
reason: Evidence and reason for this identity decision
reviewed: I reviewed both identities, their differences, the exact alias mapping and every listed relationship and audience. I confirm that this identity link is appropriate.
cancel: Return to comparison without applying a decision
manual: Keep both source workbenches available. Resolve the held issue with the responsible person, then start a new current review. No automatic workaround or permission change is available.

holds.restricted: At least one private dependency cannot be reviewed under your current access. Its identity and contents are withheld.
holds.unsupported: A dependency has no supported permission-safe impact review. Manual reconciliation is required.
holds.too_many: The dependency set exceeds the bounded review limit. Arrange a separately reviewed reconciliation.
holds.existing_merge: An existing merge or alias chain requires a separate split/reconciliation review.
holds.different_kind: The recorded identity types conflict. Verify the source records before linking them.
holds.verified_contact_conflict: The records contain different verified contact values. Confirm identity and contact verification separately before merging.
holds.changed_after_merge: A source record, dependency or audience changed after the merge. Automatic split is held so later work is preserved.
holds.already_reversed: This merge has already been split. Its history and receipts remain available.
holds.privacy_restriction: A source has a client-access privacy restriction. Linking these identities requires separate privacy reconciliation; the restriction remains in force.

openCanonical: Open the canonical identity and permitted source aliases
aliases: Source aliases you may currently read
noAliases: No additional permitted source aliases are shown.
splitReview: Review a safe split of this identity link
splitBoundary: A split removes this identity link. It keeps both source records, original audiences, source/provider references and merge history. A later incompatible change holds automatic reversal.
unknown: The decision outcome is not confirmed. Keep this operation identity and check its status before submitting another decision.
failure: The decision was not applied. Reopen the current comparison and review the records and authority again.
conflict: The records or affected references changed. The decision was not applied; reopen the current comparison before deciding again.
absent: No committed outcome was found for this submitted operation. Review current records before starting another decision.
mergeEntry: Review an identity merge or split

references.privacy_history: Retained privacy history for both source identities
